question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of natural gas transmission and distribution pipelines in Germany, with operator, diameter or pressure, and status?

answer.summary: Germany publishes no open national GIS dataset of gas transmission or distribution pipeline routes: § 15a (4) EnWG restricts the KO·NEP NEP-Gas-Datenbank to confidential use; § 23c (4)&(6) EnWG require only aggregate length tables and municipal presence maps; BIL requires project-specific excavation inquiries; and gasnetzkarte.de closed in 2011. Best open transmission option is SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN (1,087 DE 2-vertex segments, 31,272 km, DN & bar gap-filled, CC-BY-4.0) paired with LKD_Raw (1,037/1,045 operator_name, 2017) plus OSM/Geofabrik for exact mapped paths. Official open multi-vertex WFS geometries exist only in Hessen (no DN/bar/operator); full distribution+TSO GIS requires paid WGI.
main_caveats: No open official national GIS: § 15a (4) EnWG restricts NEP-Gas-Datenbank (confidentiality/legitimate interest), BIL handles excavation inquiries only, and gasnetzkarte.de shut down on 2011-01-01.

SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN & LKD_Raw cover transmission only (0 distribution), freeze at 2017–2021 snapshots, and store 100% of German pipes as 2-vertex straight lines between abstracted nodes (0/1,087 have >2 vertices).

IGGIELGN stripped operator_name before release (0/1,087) and gap-fills 43% of diameter_mm and 47.5% of max_pressure_bar with Median/Lasso heuristics; use LKD_Raw (1,037/1,045 raw operator_name, 2017) for operators.
Operational status is missing in SciGRID (start_year only on 25/1,087 IGGIELGN) and sparse in OSM; official Hessen WFS distinguishes Bestand vs Planung regionally without DN, bar, or operator.

Distribution networks (~740+ DSOs) publish § 23c (6) Nr. 4 EnWG municipal presence maps only; parcel-level pipe maps require signed Nutzungsantrag/login (NBB, enercity, BIL) or commercial WGI (80,924 km).
answer.confidence_reason: Verified EnWG §§ 15a/23c, BNetzA/KO·NEP/MaStR/GovData, 7 TSOs, 4 DSOs, regional OGC services (HE, RLP, HH, BE, SL, NI), SciGRID ZIPs (1,087 & 1,045 DE segments), Geofabrik Bremen PBF, WGI paid offer, and SEL PFB PDFs.

exclusions.value: Excludes all gas distribution networks; removed operator_name, source, exact, and num_compressor prior to release; lacks operational status.

key_fields.meaning: 2-element ISO2 array for start/end nodes (filter 'DE' in country_code)
Pipe diameter in mm (1,087/1,087 populated in DE: 612 raw, 467 Median, 8 Lasso)
Max operating pressure in bar (1,087/1,087 populated in DE: 571 raw, 483 Median, 27 heuristic, 6 Lasso)
Segment length in km
1 if high-calorific H-gas (746 raw + 341 const=1 in DE)
Commissioning year (25/1,087 raw in DE, 1977–2013; null otherwise)
Per-attribute provenance dict distinguishing 'raw' vs heuristic methods

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sSL -o /tmp/IGGIELGN.zip 'https://zenodo.org/records/4767098/files/IGGIELGN.zip?download=1' && unzip -p /tmp/IGGIELGN.zip data/IGGIELGN_PipeSegments.geojson | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); de=[f for f in d['features'] if 'DE' in f['properties']['country_code']]; print(len(de), round(sum(f['properties']['param']['length_km'] for f in de),1))"
steps: Download IGGIELGN.zip from Zenodo record 4767098 and extract data/IGGIELGN_PipeSegments.geojson (or .csv).
Filter features where 'DE' appears in properties.country_code (1,087 segments) or country_code == ['DE', 'DE'] (1,022 domestic segments).
Inspect properties.method['diameter_mm'] and properties.method['max_pressure_bar'] to separate measured ('raw') from Median/Lasso imputed values.
reading_traps: All 1,087 German geometries are 2-vertex straight node-to-node lines (0/1,087 have >2 vertices), not true curved right-of-way alignments.
operator_name was removed from all features prior to release (0/1,087); pair with LKD_Raw for operator names.
Max imputed pressure hits 220 bar and 467/483 segments get flat median values (800 mm / 70 bar) when raw values were absent.

evidence.claim: 1,087 DE-touching PipeSegments (31,272.4 km), 612 raw + 475 imputed diameters, 571 raw + 516 imputed pressures, 0/1,087 operator_name.
evidence.quote: other attributes that were part of the data set, but have been removed prior to release are: • exact • num_compressor • operator_name • source (scigrid_IGGIELGN.pdf p.130)

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sSL -o /tmp/bremen-latest.osm.pbf 'https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/germany/bremen-latest.osm.pbf' && ogrinfo -ro -q -sql "SELECT osm_id, other_tags FROM lines WHERE man_made='pipeline' AND other_tags LIKE '%\"substance\"=>\"gas\"%'" /tmp/bremen-latest.osm.pbf
how_to_use.example_result: 3 substance=gas ways in Bremen (out of 68 man_made=pipeline ways; 3/3 operator='Gasunie Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG', 0/3 diameter/pressure/usage). Ohsome POST /v1/elements/length on Ruhr bbox (6.5,51.2,7.8,51.7 @ 2026-07-27) returned 1016560.32 m.
steps: Download germany-latest.osm.pbf (4.5 GB) or smaller Bundesland .osm.pbf extracts from Geofabrik (note: no country-level .shp.zip is offered, and public Overpass mirrors frequently timeout/drop).
Filter ways in GDAL/ogr2ogr or osmium-tool for man_made='pipeline' AND substance IN ('gas','natural_gas').
Parse operator, usage, diameter, pressure, construction:* and disused:* tags from other_tags.
reading_traps: Buried distribution pipes are largely unmapped in OSM and transmission mapping varies strongly by region.
Other industrial gases (e.g. blast_furnance_gas in Bremen) match naive substring '%gas%' queries; filter strictly on substance='gas' or 'natural_gas'.
Ohsome /elements/geometry endpoint returned 403 Forbidden and full-DE Overpass mirrors failed/timed out from this environment; Geofabrik PBF is the reliable bulk route.

problems: Tested on 20.3 MB Bremen state extract (4.5 GB germany-latest.osm.pbf verified via HTTP 307->200 HEAD); incomplete buried coverage and sparse diameter/pressure/status tags.

evidence.claim: Geofabrik germany-latest.osm.pbf is 4.5 GB (2026-11-14); Bremen 20.3 MB PBF contains 3 natural-gas pipeline ways (all Gasunie, 0 diameter/pressure); Ruhr Ohsome length is 1,016.6 km.

TSOs cooperate via FNB Gas e. V. and KO·NEP; TSOs and ~100 cross-sector grid operators route site-specific route inquiries through BIL eG.

publication_obligation.norm: § 23c (4) EnWG (network lengths by pressure/DN class), § 23c (6) Nr. 4 EnWG (municipal distribution connectivity map), § 15a (4) EnWG (restricted NEP-Gas-Datenbank); § 27 GasNEV repealed; GasNZV 2010 ended gasnetzkarte.de (2011-01-01)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Annual by 1 April: aggregate network lengths (high/medium/low pressure and high-pressure DN classes A-G), plus municipal gas-connection maps for DSOs; no statutory duty to publish vector pipeline geometries openly.
publication_obligation.frequency: annual (as of 31 December prior year, published by 1 April)

consolidated_republication.note: Consolidated national vector topology is held inside NEP-Gas-Datenbank (§ 15a EnWG) under statutory non-disclosure; open consolidated outputs cover only operator identities (MaStR), planned expansion lists (KO·NEP XLSX), and tariffs (NET).

checked_pages.saw: NEP Gas approval documents and regulatory oversight; links to KO·NEP; no open national pipeline GIS.

Central NEP-Gas-Datenbank (§ 15a (4) EnWG) holds consolidated TSO network topology/data under confidentiality & berechtigtes Interesse; public NEP 2025 XLSX annexes (Anlage 1/2) list planned measure names/statuses without routes.
Consolidated open register of all 759 Gasnetzbetreiber (16 FNBs) and gas facilities under DL-DE BY 2.0 (3.2 GB XML); no pipeline routes.
Has statutory unrestricted access to NEP-Gas-Datenbank under § 15a (4) EnWG, but does not republish consolidated pipeline GIS.
Consolidated § 23b EnWG XLSX tables of gas operator cost/revenue disclosures only; no routes, DN, or pressure.

national_registry.note: § 15a (4) EnWG establishes the central NEP-Gas-Datenbank maintained by TSOs via KO·NEP (unrestricted only for BNetzA & BMWE; third parties require berechtigtes Interesse + confidentiality forbidding publication). BIL eG (bil-leitungsauskunft.de) runs an inquiry portal for excavation plans, not bulk GIS. The pre-2011 national Gasnetzkarte (gasnetzkarte.de) ended on 2011-01-01 following the Sep 2010 GasNZV amendment.

checked_pages.saw: Access to NEP-Gas-Datenbank explicitly requires legitimate interest and confidentiality agreement barring disclosure to third parties.
Regulatory portal & DataHub/Datenportal; publishes monitoring reports and links NEP/MaStR, no open pipeline geometry registry.
Federal geodata catalog (VG250, CLC, DTK, basemap.de); no natural gas pipeline vector datasets.
CKAN API search returned only scattered state/municipal energy layers (Hessen regional plans, RLP WMS, Hamburg Wärmeplanung, Berlin 250 m buffer polygons, Saarland Gemarkungen).
Describes ~40,000 km transmission network (up to 140 cm, 100 bar) and 16 FNBs; no bulk pipeline GIS export.
Project-specific Planauskunft portal for construction/excavation plans; requires user registration and inquiry polygon.
Confirms Gemeinsame Gasnetzkarte (gasnetzkarte.de) terminated 2011-01-01 after Sep 2010 GasNZV amendment.

recipe: Search uvp-verbund.de/freitextsuche?q=Gasleitung (and state Planfeststellungsbehörden such as rpk.baden-wuerttemberg.de, NRW Bezirksregierungen, or lbeg.niedersachsen.de) for § 43 EnWG pipeline procedures.
Download the Bekanntmachungstext_PFB / Planfeststellungsbeschluss PDF and Teil-A Unterlage 3 (Bau- und Betriebsmerkmale).
Extract operator name, pipeline name, nominal diameter (DN in mm), design/operating pressure (MOP in bar), segment length (km), municipality waypoints, and approval/amendment dates.
Download Teil-C Übersichtspläne (1:25,000 / 1:5,000 PDF route maps) and georeference corridor lines against DOP20 or basemap.de ATKIS Basis-DLM.
Cross-check project IDs, commissioning timelines, and operator identities against KO·NEP NEP Anlage 1 XLSX and BNetzA MaStR.
if_unstructured.location_method: Extract municipality waypoints and georeference 1:25,000 / 1:5,000 Teil-C Übersichtspläne PDF alignment maps from § 43 EnWG Planfeststellungsunterlagen onto basemap.de / DOP20 reference imagery.
cross_with: SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN & LKD_Raw (national transmission graph & historical operators)
KO·NEP NEP Gas Anlage 1 & 2 XLSX (planned project codes & Inbetriebnahme dates)
BNetzA MaStR GetOeffentlicheMarktakteure API (verified operator register)

where_published.name: Regierungspräsidium Karlsruhe — § 43 EnWG Planfeststellung (e.g. Süddeutsche Erdgasleitung SEL)
where_published.what: Full planning approval decrees (PFB), public notices (§ 43b EnWG), technical specs (Unterlage 3), and 1:25,000 / 1:5,000 alignment PDF maps for new/modified high-pressure pipelines.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Browse Referat 17 Planfeststellung pages by state Regierungspräsidium / Bezirksregierung / LBEG or search project name + 'Planfeststellungsbeschluss'.

example_document.what_it_gives: States operator (terranets bw GmbH), pipeline name (SEL), DN 1000 mm, 100 bar design pressure, ca. 62 km corridor from Mannheim-Straßenheim to Hüffenhardt, approval date 2025-03-18 (Az. 17-0513.2-7/12); same case page hosts 1:25,000 and 1:5,000 route PDF maps.

where_published.name: UVP-Verbund (Joint EIA Portal of German Federal States)
where_published.what: 52 Länder EIA/scoping procedures for natural gas pipelines (e.g. OGE, Nowega, NBB, Stadtnetze Münster) linking permitting notices and map annexes.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Filter by keyword ('Gasleitung', 'Erdgasleitung') and category; inspect slowly to avoid Nginx HTTP 429 rate limits on detail URLs.

example_document.what_it_gives: LBEG § 43 EnWG public notice PDF naming GASCADE & NEL Gastransport GmbH infrastructure project in Rehden (Az. L1.4/L67301/02-12_02/2015-0003/106).

related_not_answering.name: ENTSOG Maps & Transparency Platform (EMAP / API)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes European schematic poster PDF maps and operational flow/entry-exit APIs, but not open pipeline route line geometries with pressure/diameter/status.

related_not_answering.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) — Gasnetzbetreiber
related_not_answering.why: Open DL-DE BY 2.0 XML/JSON census of 759 Gasnetzbetreiber (16 FNBs) and point facilities, containing zero pipeline route geometries.

related_not_answering.name: LBEG Niedersachsen Leitungskataster & NIBIS Kartenserver
related_not_answering.why: LBEG maintains a non-public internal specialist registry of Lower Saxony pipelines; its public NIBIS WMS packages cover geology/hydrocarbons only.

related_not_answering.name: Geoportal Berlin — Energienetze (WFS ea_energienetze)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes 250 m buffer polygons only; explicitly withholds pipeline line geometry for data-protection reasons.

related_not_answering.name: Hamburg & Saarland Wärmeplanung / Wärmeatlas WFS
related_not_answering.why: Hamburg exposes settlement area polygons for municipal heat planning and Saarland exposes Gemarkungen (cadastral district) polygons, not pipeline routes.

related_not_answering.name: Netzentgelttransparenzportal (NET — § 23b EnWG)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes consolidated operator revenue/tariff XLSX tables only; zero geometry, DN, or pressure.

related_not_answering.name: Gemeinsame Gasnetzkarte (gasnetzkarte.de — historical)
related_not_answering.why: Discontinued on 2011-01-01 after the Sep 2010 GasNZV amendment removed the mandate for a joint public web gas-network map; gasnetzkarte.de resets connection.

open_questions: Exact proportion of Germany's ~740+ DSOs participating in BIL eG vs operating proprietary Planauskunft portals without registering/submitting a project plan.
Whether RLP ROK25 Gasversorgung WMS displays pipeline vectors in its interactive browser session behind the GeoPortal RLP WAF viewer wrapper (failed direct OGC GFI/GetMap).

history.note: Initial survey: no open national pipeline GIS (NEP-Gas-Datenbank restricted; BIL project-only; gasnetzkarte.de closed 2011). Regional open WFS in Hessen; national open transmission via SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN + LKD_Raw & OSM.

local_terms.meaning: High-pressure long-distance gas transmission network and its 16 operators in Germany
Regional and local gas distribution grid and operator (~740+ companies in Germany)
Biennial § 15a EnWG national transmission development plan (KO·NEP / BNetzA)
Site-specific underground utility location inquiry required before excavation (e.g. BIL eG)
Formal § 43 EnWG planning approval decree publishing approved corridor plans and technical specs
Nominal internal pipeline diameter in mm (classed A–G under § 23c EnWG) and maximum operating pressure in bar

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
